The creator argues that pointing tools like Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor at a one-line prompt produces messy results, and instead separates the work into two layers: ChatGPT/Claude as the Architect that produces a structured project folder, and a coding agent as the Builder that consumes it. The handoff between the two is the folder of purpose-built Markdown files — not a chat thread or a single bloated CLAUDE.md / CODEX.md. No transcript was available, so this article is reconstructed from the title, description, and chapter list only.
